cards.title: Why it works
items: The wait is a machine gate polling a check command — parked costs no tokens, unlike an agent sleeping in a loop
A cheap agent bootstrap installs the probe; only the release event wakes a model
Poll cadence and exit-code contract live in the gate bytes, reviewable without running anything

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes: bootstrap agent -> watch machine gate -> report agent; {{edges}} edges
Report reads the gate's committed answer — attempt count and timestamps come from the machine record
